formula: 10 minus 3 per missing beat, minus 1 per beat out of order

beats.notes: Arrival, ford-stone check and unanimous agreement all present. The two beacon poles are never named in the draft and the theodolite appears only in the Midsummer reckoning rather than as cargo — a partial element, not a missing beat, and not deducted twice.
Duration and last-walker given; three further phrasings before he stops.
Chest unlocked, book handed over, refusal to read, Creed-length and last walker given instead.
Four-course Sile, first field-book entry, Midsummer day-count.
Arrival after dark with the lantern, supper, standing-witness offer, Raven Hause remark. The draft does not say Brock rode; nothing contradicts it.
